video_review.reviewer: Codex /root/scenarios/refs_workspaces; inline full PNGs, paired terminal JSON and sampled MP4 contact sheet
video_review.summary: Sampled review, not a real-time watch: 16 frames across 28.73 seconds show workspace selection, sustained native scoped status/diff/log, return by Backspace, paced explicit show -r scratch@ and evolog -r scratch@ command entry and held results. Captions explain that the workspace log is read-only and command scope needs an explicit revision. No fixture setup appears. Three paired assertions preserve workspace registrations and both workspaces' expected file contents. Native views and captured output differ noticeably in background styling; headers clip long repository paths.
